_readme: Which row of the paradata (src/data/paradata.json) each part of the 3D scene shows in the 'measured or guessed' view. A part's id is set as userData.paradata on its object, or per vertex in the merged meshes (src/world/paradataTags.js). 'decision' is the row whose element describes the part most closely; its status is the one shown. null: no row in paradata_3 covers the part, and the view shows it as 'not recorded'. 'why' says which row was chosen and why. The choice of row is the assistant's (17 November 2026) and waits for the reconstructor's check.
